description: OsirisZk is a student-led space technology team from Altıeylül BİLSEM, Türkiye, supported by a mathematics educator. Our strengths include FPV drone systems, flight simulation, coding, and mathematical modeling. For NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, we aim to develop an interactive Mars exploration mission game that combines realistic flight physics, scientific data, and mission planning. We welcome collaborators interested in aerospace, robotics, software, and planetary exploration.
